description: A Tier 1 entry built from a subset of the entry points must not serve a later full build: a script edit rebuilt on its own caches introspection for main.pk only, and the next full build must still route /about

stages.description: Initial full build with all entry points (main.pk + about.pk)
Script edit to main.pk rebuilt with only main.pk as an entry point - misses Tier 1 and caches introspection built from that subset under the project-wide hash
Full build with no further edits - the subset Tier 1 entry does not cover about.pk, so it must be treated as stale and /about must still render
